scale.order: Higher means better;0 is the lowest valid rating,5 the highest,1-4 ordered intermediate categories
scale.original_rubric: 0-3 plus NA; preserve its hash and document this alternate-instrument deviation
scale.recoding: None. Original numerical strings are preserved; parsing a strict integer0..5 does not rescale or replace its value. Do not standardize to0-3.

inputs.hash_binding: The write-once pre-unblinding analysis lock must bind this amendment, exact declaration, original submission, immutable package, analysis source/tests and input manifests. Require its external SHA for analysis. No source changes between lock and analysis.

admissible_outcomes.classification: Genuine principal-researcher reported ordinal judgments with retrospectively clarified order; perceived linguistic resemblance is not independently validated whole-person/behavioral Persona Fidelity.
admissible_outcomes.intake: 99 unique known assigned IDs, each with all3 strict numeric0..5 primary ratings; retain100 allocated rows and exactlyone wholly missing record as UNAVAILABLE with null ratings. Immutable package displayed text and protected-map display hashes must match the actual archived responses before condition analysis.
admissible_outcomes.missingness: The one absent record is an unavailable intended-primary rating, not zero. Numeric0 remains observed. Structural NA, unknown IDs, altered source cells or another missing/incompatible primary value fail this fixed analysis rather than being imputed or silently excluded.
excluded_from_outcome_analysis: Secondary history/temporal/behavioral/completeness ratings: unresolved applicability and evidence requirements
Claim counts and paraphrased evidence: no verified atomic claim/response/source-span traceability under the registered instrument
Numeric confidence: not a calibrated probability or the registered ordinal confidence labels
admissible_outcomes.excluded_preservation: All raw secondary/count/evidence/rationale/confidence/status fields retained unchanged. Aggregate structural QC may be reported, but no fabricated repair, confidence weighting, factual-accuracy estimate or temporal-reliability score.
admissible_outcomes.interpretation: Do not call any category cutoff good/acceptable/success, assign invented verbal anchors, equate shorter/overlapping text with quality, or infer reviewer independence from numeric validity.

analysis.allocation: Exactly5 development speakers,2 contexts each,C0-C7 plusM_STYLE/N_STYLE;80factorial and20style-control responses
analysis.condition_distributions: For every primary domain and all10conditions report six category counts, missingness, ordered empirical distribution and category median or central-category pair; do not compute a cardinal mean of0-5 ratings.
analysis.paired_main_effects: For each domain,S/F/H compare factor-on versus factor-off within the same speaker/context/other-factor stratum:4strata x2contexts per speaker,40allocated pairs per main effect. Report win,tie,loss proportions and net wins minus losses. Positive means the higher-factor condition was rated above the paired comparator, not a cardinal improvement.
analysis.style_controls: Prespecified C7 versus M_STYLE,C7 versus N_STYLE,C7 versus C6;2paired contexts per speaker,10pairs each. Same win/tie/loss and distributional analyses, never choose only a favorable control.
analysis.factorial_distributions: For EACH of the5 ordered cuts k=1..5, define binary Y_k=1(rating>=k). Report all7 original S,F,H,SF,SH,FH,SFH contrasts using2*mean(product of selected+/-1codes*Y_k), within each context then equal contexts per speaker then equal speakers. This is an entire ordinal distribution-effect profile. Do NOT average acrosscuts, pick a favorable cutoff, call the categories equally spaced, or confuse factorial-scaled interactions with unscaled differences-in-differences.
analysis.pairing_and_completeness: Full estimand uses all5speakers with2contexts and allstrata equal-weight. Report complete-speaker estimates as an explicitly changed subset estimand with actual included speaker counts. Do not silently unequal-weight a partially observed speaker. Coverage counts by condition and contrast are mandatory.
analysis.unavailable_bounds: Enumerate the one unavailable category over all6 ordered categories, separately by outcome domain, retaining each entire profile so category cuts stay nested. Report min/max full5-speaker estimates across these6 completions for every contrast, cutoff and paired category. These are logical missing-outcome bounds, NOT imputed ratings, confidence/credible intervals or observed full-cohort point estimates. Marginal bounds across domains do not assert joint attainability.
analysis.speaker_uncertainty: Report sorted speaker-specific contrast values/ranges and leave-one-speaker-out influence for complete-speaker estimates. With five dependent same-group speakers and few contexts, do not claim calibrated p-values, confidence intervals, bootstrap population precision or independent responses. Missing-completion sensitivity and speaker influence are separate uncertainty sources.
analysis.quality_efficiency: For the same main-effect/control pairs, cross-tabulate ordinal win/tie/loss against observed faster/equal/slower completion wall latency. Equal means exact recorded equality; speed signs are nominal observations, not a meaningful-speed threshold. Report coverage, equal-speaker summaries and missing-category bounds. No rating-per-second ratio or ordinal score arithmetic. Existing latency is CPU-backend elapsed time with load/order/restart limitations, not energy or per-condition process peak RAM.
non_analyses: No cardinal0-5 score means or equal-interval regression
No significance fishing, tuned success thresholds or posthoc exclusion
No conditional factual-accuracy claim from untraceable human claim lists
No new human labels or reconstruction of intermediate anchors
No causal mediation claim from length or cost correlations
